newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel A up 5.05 pct on GNP news.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel A up 5.05 pct on GNP news.

text.p: San Miguel A shares rose by 2.50 pesos, or 5.05 percent, to 52 pesos at midsession on Monday on buying triggered by news of strong nine-month gross national product (GNP) data, brokers said.

"San Miguel A shares are on the rise because of good GNP figures. It's always been like that. If the GNP is up, San Miguel shares are also on the uptrend," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Citisecurities Inc.
On Saturday, the government announced that nine-month GNP grew by 7.1 percent from a 5.3 percent growth during the same period last year.
SMC B shares gained 2.0 pesos, or 1.9 percent, to 107 pesos.
A total of 1.086 million San Miguel A shares were traded by midsession along with 80,470 San Miguel B shares.
